text: The Corporations Nominating Panel will select candidates to be interviewed for appointment to the CreateTO Board. The Nominating Panel will conduct interviews at its next meeting and recommend two candidates to City Council for appointment.

The Corporations Nominating Panel: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the CreateTO Board: Candidate TRB2-367 Candidate TRB2-376 Candidate TRB2-386 Candidate TRB2-404 Candidate TRB2-425 Candidate TRB2-427 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1a, 1b, and 2 to the report (September 23, 2024) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the CreateTO Board.
